fields.label: Image Path Field
fields.help: Item field holding the local image path. Defaults to image_path, path, file_path, or media_path (first non-empty).

fields.label: Target Format
fields.help: Output image format. jpg is accepted as an alias for jpeg; webp can be decoded but not written.

fields.label: JPEG Quality
fields.help: JPEG encode quality (only used when format is jpeg).

fields.label: Output Field
fields.help: Item field where the output file path is written.

fields.label: Output Directory
fields.help: Directory for the converted file. Defaults to the source image's directory. ~ is expanded.
